map.docker run 一长串命令行参数，迁移到 docker-compose 时: A long docker run command line has to be mapped field by field into YAML when you migrate to docker-compose. This tool parses the common options and generates a Compose snippet you can paste straight in, making multi-container orchestration easier to manage.
map.📖 查看「Docker Run 转 Compose使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Docker Run to Compose Guide"
map.把 docker run 命令转换为 docker-compose 配置。: Converts a docker run command into docker-compose configuration.
map.：需处理引号包裹与反斜杠续行的多行命令。: : quoted arguments and backslash line continuations in multi-line commands must be handled.
map.：生成 YAML 时注意缩进一致与含特殊字符值的引号包裹。: : when emitting YAML, keep indentation consistent and quote values that contain special characters.
map.支持参数：-d/--detach、-p/--publish、-v/--volum: Supported options: -d/--detach, -p/--publish, -v/--volume, -e/--env, --name and --restart. Other unrecognised flags are skipped during parsing and can be added to the Compose file by hand.
map.compose 默认以后台运行，原 -d 无需对应字段；restart 策略沿用: Compose runs in the background by default, so -d needs no counterpart field; the restart policy keeps its original value such as unless-stopped, always or no.
map.本解析为轻量级：不支持 --network、--link、多值 -e 合并等复杂: This parser is lightweight: complex forms such as --network, --link and multi-value -e merging are not supported, so validate the output locally with docker compose config.
map.📚 深度解析：Docker Run to Compose: 📚 Deep Dive: Docker Run to Compose
map.把 docker run 命令转 docker-compose。: Convert a docker run command to docker-compose.
map.把线上正在用的 docker run 命令转成 compose 文件，固化到仓库: Turn the docker run command actually running in production into a Compose file committed to the repository, so the team can reproduce the environment instead of passing flags around by word of mouth.
map.compose 与 run 的表达能力不完全对等：复杂网络配置、--securi: Compose and run are not fully equivalent in expressive power: complex network configuration, the fine-grained options of --security-opt, and shell variables or pipes all need manual adjustment. After converting, always validate the structure with docker compose config and start it once in a test environment to confirm the behaviour matches.
